conflicts.permit: In connection with such use, certain personally identifiable user and/or membership data may be transferred automatically to and from XAntGames.
conflicts.prohibit: We retain the right to collect and store identifying information for the sole purpose of providing user accounts to improve the quality, features and user experience of our Services.
conflicts.situation: Transferring personally identifiable user data to and from third-party authentication services like social networks or gaming consoles.
conflicts.reason: The policy restricts collection and storage of identifying info to the 'sole purpose' of user accounts, yet allows automated transfer of PII for external authentication.
